review_candidates.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
review_candidates.description: Senior Cloud Security Engineer Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Security Engineer to strengthen and maintain the security of our cloud infrastructure, primarily across AWS, with additional experience in Azure and enterprise identity management. The role will be responsible for implementing cloud security strategies, managing access controls, identifying and addressing security vulnerabilities, and ensuring the protection of infrastructure, applications, and business data. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on technical expertise in AWS security, cloud governance, and identity management, with the ability to drive security improvements and collaborate effectively with cross-functional technical teams. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain security controls across AWS cloud environments, including accounts, workloads, networks, storage, and databases. Establish AWS security standards, organizational guardrails, and Service Control Policies (SCPs) to ensure consistent security governance. Assess and secure Azure environments, including subscriptions, resources, network configurations, and access permissions. Manage and maintain AWS IAM and Microsoft Entra ID, including roles, policies, identity federation, service accounts, and privileged access. Enforce least-privilege access principles and implement MFA, Conditional Access, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM). Develop and maintain access management procedures, including provisioning, periodic access reviews, and access revocation. Monitor cloud environments to detect vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, unauthorized access, and potential security threats. Investigate, prioritize, and remediate security findings using CSPM/CNAPP solutions and cloud security monitoring tools. Implement and maintain encryption, secrets management, and key management controls to protect sensitive data and cloud resources. Participate in cloud security incident investigations and support threat containment, remediation, and recovery activities. Review Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates and deployment configurations to identify security risks and ensure secure implementations. Implement standardized security controls across cloud environments and support secure infrastructure deployments. Evaluate production changes from a security perspective, ensuring appropriate risk assessments, testing, and rollback procedures. Develop automation scripts to improve security monitoring, assessments, and repetitive operational tasks. Maintain cloud security documentation, technical configurations, audit records, and operational procedures. Work closely with infrastructure, development, and security operations teams to integrate security controls into cloud operations and deployments. Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to support continuous improvement of cloud security practices. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, information security, or cybersecurity, with significant hands-on experience in AWS security. Strong practical knowledge of AWS security services, AWS IAM, AWS Organizations, and Service Control Policies (SCPs). Hands-on experience securing Azure resources and managing Microsoft Entra ID configurations. Solid understanding of cloud security architecture, network security, encryption, logging, and security governance. Good knowledge of identity and access management concepts, including RBAC, SSO, identity federation, MFA, and Privileged Access Management (PAM). Experience working with CSPM/CNAPP platforms, cloud security monitoring, vulnerability management, and workload protection solutions. Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or equivalent. Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and automated security implementations. Knowledge of secrets management, cloud security posture management, and hybrid identity integration. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities, with the capability to identify security risks and implement effective remediation. Ability to evaluate infrastructure changes, assess security implications, and implement appropriate risk mitigation measures. Experience in e-commerce or high-availability customer-facing environments is an advantage. Relevant AWS, Azure, or cybersecurity certifications are preferred. Excellent command of both English and Arabic.
